description: This source file defines the ThingsAggregatorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for aggregating retrieved things from persistence based on specific commands (RetrieveThings and SudoRetrieveThings). It handles message reception, constructs retrieval commands, and streams responses back to the sender with considerations for parallel execution and timeouts.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that handles aggregation of 'things' retrieved from a persistence layer. It processes commands to retrieve things either normally or with elevated privileges, manages concurrent retrievals, and streams results back to requesters.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for configuring instances of ThingsAggregatorActor with a specified target actor, using a dedicated dispatcher.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic for the actor, including patterns for RetrieveThings, SudoRetrieveThings, and unknown messages.

methods.name: retrieveThings
methods.description: Handles retrieval logic for normal RetrieveThings command, extracting field selection and delegating to retrieveThingsAndSendResult.

methods.name: retrieveThings
methods.description: Overloaded method handling SudoRetrieveThings command, similarly extracting field selection and delegating.

methods.name: retrieveThingsAndSendResult
methods.description: Constructs retrieval commands for each ThingId, applies filtering, wraps commands, and executes parallel retrievals, streaming the response back to the sender.

methods.name: calculateParallelism
methods.description: Calculates optimal parallelism level based on number of ThingIds and configured maximum.
